constraints.definition: CHECK ((((outcome)::text <> 'SUCCESS'::text) OR ((user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (session_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((reason_code)::text = 'SUCCESS'::text))))

CHECK (((((menu_type)::text = 'DIRECTORY'::text) AND (route_path IS NOT NULL) AND ((route_path)::text ~~ '/%'::text) AND (component_key IS NULL) AND (permission_id IS NULL)) OR (((menu_type)::text = 'PAGE'::text) AND (route_path IS NOT NULL) AND ((route_path)::text ~~ '/%'::text) AND (component_key IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim((component_key)::text) <> ''::text) AND (permission_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (((menu_type)::text = 'BUTTON'::text) AND (route_path IS NULL) AND (component_key IS NULL) AND (permission_id IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((NOT is_builtin) OR ((code)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['USER'::character varying, 'ADMIN'::character varying, 'SUPER_ADMIN'::character varying])::text[]))))

CHECK (((((setting_key)::text = 'registration_enabled'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(setting_value) = 'boolean'::text)) OR (((setting_key)::text = 'site_name'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(setting_value) = 'string'::text) AND ((char_length((setting_value #>> '{}'::text[])) >= 1) AND (char_length((setting_value #>> '{}'::text[])) <= 30)) AND ((setting_value #>> '{}'::text[]) ~ '[^[:space:]]'::text))))

CHECK ((((pending_time_zone IS NULL) AND (time_zone_effective_at IS NULL)) OR ((pending_time_zone IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim((pending_time_zone)::text) <> ''::text) AND ((pending_time_zone)::text <> (time_zone)::text) AND (time_zone_effective_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK ((((char_length((username)::text) >= 1) AND (char_length((username)::text) <= 30)) AND (((username)::text COLLATE "C") ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9㐀-䶿一-鿿豈-﫿𠀀-𯨟]+$'::text)))

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_login_log_pkey ON public.identity_login_log USING btree (id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_menu_pkey ON public.identity_menu USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_identity_menu_parent ON public.identity_menu USING btree (parent_id, sort_order, id) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX ix_identity_menu_permission ON public.identity_menu USING btree (permission_id) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_identity_menu_route ON public.identity_menu USING btree (route_path) WHERE ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (route_path IS NOT NULL))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_operation_log_pkey ON public.identity_operation_log USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_identity_operation_log_actor_time ON public.identity_operation_log USING btree (actor_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX ix_identity_operation_log_target_time ON public.identity_operation_log USING btree (target_user_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX ix_identity_operation_log_time ON public.identity_operation_log USING btree (occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_permission_code_key ON public.identity_permission USING btree (code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_permission_pkey ON public.identity_permission USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_role_code_key ON public.identity_role USING btree (code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_role_pkey ON public.identity_role USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_role_menu_pkey ON public.identity_role_menu USING btree (role_id, menu_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_identity_role_menu_reverse ON public.identity_role_menu USING btree (menu_id, role_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_role_permission_pkey ON public.identity_role_permission USING btree (role_id, permission_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_identity_role_permission_reverse ON public.identity_role_permission USING btree (permission_id, role_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_setting_pkey ON public.identity_setting USING btree (setting_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_user_pkey ON public.identity_user USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_identity_user_active_page ON public.identity_user USING btree (created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX ix_identity_user_pending_timezone ON public.identity_user USING btree (time_zone_effective_at, id) WHERE ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (pending_time_zone IS NOT NULL))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_identity_user_username ON public.identity_user USING btree (lower(((username)::text COLLATE "C")))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_user_role_pkey ON public.identity_user_role USING btree (user_id, role_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_identity_user_role_reverse ON public.identity_user_role USING btree (role_id, user_id)
